problem: A REAL ¥39.90 challenge_39_9 payment (order XSG179063421831355dvw8 / txn 4500000468202609293533867714 / relatedId CR1790632776226vtmih6) settled (order=paid, payments=1, entitlement_grants.status=granted) but the challenge was NEVER unlocked: challenge_records.trialMode stayed true and `unlocked` was never written. ROOT CAUSE: the deployed challenge-unlock writer used `where({ _id: relatedId, openid })` while relatedId is the business recordId (CR…), so the Mongo _id never matched → 0 rows updated, yet entitlement_grants was marked granted unconditionally (false-positive marker). Secondary defects: (a) report branch selected by `permList.includes('full_report')` (permission bleed) instead of explicit product authority; (b) two divergent entitlement implementations (common/entitlement.js vs entitlementService.js); (c) getChallengeRecord did not return `unlocked`; (d) entitlements were granted even when the target mutation updated 0 rows.

changes.CANONICAL_ENTITLEMENT: One authoritative implementation: cloudfunctions/common/entitlementService.js (byte-identical copies at verifyPayment/lib + payCallback/lib). grantEntitlements now: (1) routes ONLY by explicit product authority (product.permission==='report_unlock' | 'challenge_unlock' | membership product.type) — no permList.includes bleed; (2) applies exactly-one target; (3) re-reads and PROVES the target before returning success; (4) returns success=false on missing/ambiguous/zero-update/未证明.
changes.CHALLENGE_TARGET_AUTHORITY: applyChallengeUnlock: target = challenge_records.where({ recordId: relatedId, openid }); requires exactly 1 match (0 = fail; >1 = fail closed + entitlement_audit); writes trialMode=false, unlocked=true, unlockOrderId, unlockedAt; re-reads to prove (trialMode===false || unlocked===true). Legacy `_id: relatedId` selector removed.
changes.REPORT_TARGET_AUTHORITY: applyReportUnlock: target = ai_reports.where({ reportId: relatedId, openid }); requires exactly 1; sets isPaid=true (+unlockOrderId, unlockedAt); re-reads to prove isPaid===true. Idempotent when already isPaid.
changes.MEMBERSHIP_IDEMPOTENCY: applyMembership: idempotency authority = the paid orderId already recorded in memberships (where {openid, orderId}); same-order replay does NOT extend duration again; a NEW order legitimately extends. vip_month_99 (30d) & vip_year_299 (365d) covered.
changes.GRANT_STATE_MACHINE: paymentFinalizer._ensureGrant: entitlement_grants now carries status applying→granted|failed + applied:boolean. Marker is created as applying; promoted to granted ONLY after target proof (grantEntitlements success). Claim is CAS-guarded (create-unique, or takeover of failed/stale-or-any applying), so exactly one applier runs under verify+callback concurrency. marker.applied===true is required to trust-and-skip; a legacy granted marker with applied!==true is NOT trusted → reconciled (CAS to applying + re-apply + prove). Crash re-entry re-runs idempotently. orderId unique index remains the idempotency authority.
changes.PRODUCT_ROUTING: permissionEngine (canonical, byte-identical across common/verifyPayment/payCallback) now maps challenge_39_9 and report_9_9 explicitly. UI permission strings are decoupled from storage mutations (documented).
changes.CLIENT_ALIGNMENT: getChallengeRecord now returns BOTH trialMode (fail-closed: !== false) and unlocked (=== true). Canonical client rule: unlocked===true || trialMode===false (challenge-play guard already consumes exactly this; no client code change).
changes.TESTS: tests/rc8.9/entitlement-authority.test.js — A–R, 64 assertions (challenge happy/missing/ambiguous/zero-update, selector regression, crash-recovery, legacy false-positive reconcile, dup verify, dup callback, verify+callback concurrency, no cross-product mutation, report happy/missing, vip month/year single-extension, explicit routing, copy integrity). Existing payment-finalizer.test.js (59) passes unchanged against the new marker shape.

deployNote: verifyPayment + payCallback share the canonical entitlementService/paymentFinalizer/permissionEngine copies; getChallengeRecord for the unlocked field. Use scripts/deploy-payment-functions.sh for the payment fns (secret + signing guards).
rollbackPlan: git revert <this-commit> + redeploy verifyPayment/payCallback/getChallengeRecord. No schema/index changes to reverse. Reconciliation of the affected order is idempotent and independently revertible.
